publicationDecision.authorisation: Matt's standing Medicines Watch instruction authorises needed evidence-backed informational additions and corrections to go live without repeat permission.
publicationDecision.scope: Add two previously untracked muscle-preservation programmes after primary-source review: clinical-stage taldefgrobep alfa and preclinical RV-8451. Editorial authorisation is not clinical approval.

reviewType: AI-assisted primary-source factual review; not clinical approval

entries.name: Taldefgrobep alfa / BHV-2000
entries.stage: Phase 2 active, not recruiting; no results posted
entries.summary: Biohaven completed enrolment in a US Phase 2 dose-ranging monotherapy study of weekly and four-weekly taldefgrobep alfa in adults with overweight or obesity. The registry records an actual 24 November 2025 start, an estimated September 2026 completion and no posted results.
entries.ukAuthorisation: The reviewed evidence does not establish UK marketing authorisation for taldefgrobep alfa in obesity.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established by the reviewed sources.
entries.supply: An investigational US study does not establish lawful UK retail supply, pharmacy stock or sale by Shift Some Timber.
entries.limitations: The sponsor's lean-mass and metabolic statements are development aims, not demonstrated Phase 2 outcomes. Enrolment completion and a past estimated study-completion month do not prove the trial is complete or that topline results exist. The registry has no posted results. Weekly and four-weekly regimens remain investigational; no efficacy, muscle-preservation, strength, function, durability, safety, superiority or combination benefit is established.

additionalEvidence.title: Biohaven: Phase 2 taldefgrobep obesity study completes enrolment
additionalEvidence.checkScope: Complete sponsor announcement read for enrolment, study design, planned dose schedules and planned endpoints. Sponsor descriptions of potential benefit are not treated as results. Not automatically content-monitored.

additionalEvidence.title: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT07281495: taldefgrobep alfa in adults with overweight and obesity
additionalEvidence.checkScope: Full registry record read. Active, not recruiting; actual start 24 November 2025; estimated September 2026 completion; estimated enrolment 150; no posted results. Not automatically content-monitored.

additionalEvidence.title: Biohaven second-quarter 2026 business update
additionalEvidence.checkScope: Sponsor update read to confirm enrolment remained complete and that topline timing was still forward-looking. Not automatically content-monitored.

entries.name: RV-8451
entries.stage: Preclinical oral GLP-1 programme; IND submission planned
entries.summary: Rivus is developing RV-8451 as an oral non-peptide GLP-1 receptor agonist for obesity. The reviewed evidence is limited to diet-induced-obesity non-human-primate studies; the sponsor says IND-enabling work is under way and plans a US IND submission for Q1 2027.
entries.ukAuthorisation: The reviewed evidence does not establish UK marketing authorisation or a UK clinical-trial authorisation for RV-8451.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established by the reviewed sources.
entries.supply: Preclinical development and a planned US IND submission do not establish lawful UK retail supply, pharmacy stock or sale by Shift Some Timber.
entries.limitations: All reported weight, fat, lean-mass and tolerability findings are sponsor-reported preclinical non-human-primate data. They do not establish human efficacy, muscle preservation, strength, function, safety, gastrointestinal tolerability, superiority to orforglipron, durability or an approved regimen. A planned Q1 2027 IND submission is not a completed filing or a started human trial.

additionalEvidence.title: Rivus: preclinical RV-8451 data at ADA 2026
additionalEvidence.checkScope: Complete sponsor announcement read for modality, preclinical species, study durations, reported endpoints and planned IND timing. Preclinical comparisons are not presented as human benefit or superiority. Not automatically content-monitored.

additionalEvidence.title: Rivus oral-medicines pipeline
additionalEvidence.checkScope: Full readable sponsor pipeline page reviewed to confirm RV-8451 remains in IND-enabling studies. Publication and update dates were not displayed and remain unknown. Not automatically content-monitored.

configuredSourcePass.boundary: The SELECT-only health response verifies configured-source availability and monitor operation. It does not renew factual reviews, approve changed wording or establish complete industry coverage. The unchanged Zealand 403 remains visible and is not repeated as a new alert.

discoveryPass.method: A current-date search and a broader undated mechanism-and-stage pass checked regulator, registry and sponsor sources, including smaller developers, muscle-preservation approaches, preclinical programmes, active trials and stopped programmes. Results were reconciled with current main and open review PRs.
discoveryPass.included: Taldefgrobep alfa is a previously untracked active Phase 2 myostatin/activin programme. RV-8451 is a previously untracked preclinical oral non-peptide GLP-1 programme. Their clinical stages and evidence limits remain separate.
discoveryPass.notDuplicated: COURAGE trevogrumab, apitegromab, bimagrumab, enobosarm, WVE-007, SRSD384, ART27.13 and RJVA-002 are already represented. GitHub reported no open review PRs at review time.
incompleteChecks: ClinicalTrials.gov returned a complete record for taldefgrobep but no human RV-8451 record was expected or located because the sponsor describes IND-enabling preclinical work.

Search indexing can lag and selected results cannot exclude older omissions, unannounced programmes or additional international developers. Catalogue and configured-source counts do not establish industry completeness.
